item.title: How to integrate CoreUI Pro with Angular enterprise apps
item.description:
Integrating CoreUI Pro into an Angular enterprise application requires a strategic approach to handle professional components, private registries, and scalable architecture.
As the creator of CoreUI, I have architected dozens of enterprise-grade dashboards using this exact workflow. The most efficient and modern solution involves configuring a private registry for the Pro packages and leveraging standalone components for a lean, high-performance bundle.
By following this guide, you will ensure your application is built on a reliable foundation with access to advanced features like the Smart Table.

item.title: How to integrate CoreUI with React for enterprise apps
item.description: Building enterprise-level applications requires a robust architecture, consistent UI, and scalable components that can handle complex data flows. As the creator of CoreUI, I have designed our React library specifically to meet these professional requirements. Since 2014, I have focused on refining React and Node.js ecosystems to ensure they meet the rigorous standards of corporate environments. Integrating CoreUI with React provides a battle-tested foundation that simplifies state management and UI consistency across large teams.
